entities.name: Tam
entities.description: An artificial gorgon sent to measure Innistrad, who tests a new petrifying-like gaze, befriends an innkeeper and is trapped in a psychic vision by the monster in the moon.

entities.name: Moiren
entities.description: A sturdy retired parish blade and innkeeper on the Innistrad moor who kills vampires and teaches Tam about suffering.

entities.name: The Monster in the Moon
entities.description: An ancient entity trapped in Innistrad's moon that prunes worlds by eating planes and tries to learn where the Echoverse is.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker who enters the Echoverse through a mage-ring and joins the strike team against the Theorist.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who senses Jace and leads the rescue of Liliana.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker who identifies the false Liliana by scent.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A huge planeswalker druid and hunter who wants revenge on Liliana and detects Opal's deception by smell.

entities.name: Professor Opal
entities.description: The Echoverse's healer version of Liliana, who impersonates Liliana to lure the allies into a time loop.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: The true necromancer planeswalker whom the allies came to rescue.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: The planeswalker mind-mage whose Echoverse the allies enter.

entities.name: The Theorist
entities.description: The clinical version of Jace who rules the Echoverse and whom Tam consults.

entities.name: Gideon
entities.description: A friend whom Chandra uses to test whether Liliana is real, and whom the false Liliana calls the distant past.

entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: A vampire friend whom Tam thinks of when she sees the Innistrad vampires.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: An angel the innkeeper thanks for watching over the survivors.

entities.name: Hanweir
entities.description: A town that merged into a monstrous Town and was slain by cathars.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A grim gothic plane of moors, vampires and a moon-trapped monster.

entities.name: The Echoverse
entities.description: The Theorist's replacement Multiverse whose hub tower the allies enter.

entities.name: Hexhaven Academy
entities.description: The impossible tower academy with twisting stairs and shifting gravity.

entities.name: The Cathars
entities.description: Innistrad's church warriors, who hunted down Hanweir.

entities.name: The Travails
entities.description: The near-apocalypse on Innistrad when a monster in the moon nearly ended the plane.

events.summary: Tam measures Innistrad's dimensions and discovers she can briefly freeze a rat with her gaze without petrifying it.
events.quote: The rat does not move, but does not turn to stone.

events.summary: Tam reaches an inn and learns from Moiren about the Travails and how cathars killed the Town.
events.quote: "My uncle died the day the town became the Town.

events.summary: Tam has her first beer, and Moiren tells her that suffering is the only constant and the church teaches death is rest.
events.quote: "The church teaches that death is the rest we are rewarded in the end.

events.summary: Three vampires attack the inn; Moiren fights them and Tam freezes them with her gaze so Moiren can behead them.
events.quote: Tam stares , and all three vampires freeze in place.

events.summary: Moiren tells Tam she is worth saving.
At night Tam reaches out telepathically, and the monster in the moon yanks her mind into a psychic prison.
events.quote: Something hears her and yanks her up.

events.summary: The monster speaks through an emaciated puppet woman, saying it eats time and hungers for her knowledge.
events.quote: I have eaten time , says the woman

events.summary: Tam braids the puppet's hair to appease it, and learns it eats planes.
The monster demands to be shown where Tam's Multiverse is and offers to rid her of it; Tam escapes.
events.quote: Run! Tam can't help the scream she lets out

events.summary: Vraska enters the Echoverse through a mage-ring and finds details made for her, like the leaves matching her eyes.
events.quote: the yellow in the tree leaves is the exact same shade as her eyes

events.summary: Vraska meets Chandra, Ajani and Garruk after they slog through ooze, and they argue about Liliana, whom Garruk wants revenge on.
events.quote: "Stand aside and permit me my revenge," Garruk says with deadly calm. "The witch cursed me."

events.summary: The four climb the tower and meet a woman in white who embraces Chandra and says she came willingly.
events.quote: "I don't need to be saved. I came willingly."

events.summary: Garruk, Ajani and Chandra expose the woman as not Liliana, and Vraska punches her unconscious.
events.quote: Vraska doesn't hesitate. She swings her legs over the desk and socks Liliana at the angle of her jaw.

events.summary: The false Liliana heals herself, reveals she will tell the Theorist and runs off.
events.quote: "Now, if you'll excuse me, the Theorist needs to know you're here, and uncooperative,"

events.summary: The allies chase through looping halls and burst into Opal's office, where hours have passed and they are injured with lost memories.
events.quote: When did I get in a fight ?

events.summary: Ajani speaks Greek, Garruk's muscles twitch and Chandra is lost, showing Jace's effects; Opal says they fought Jace three times.
events.quote: "Oh, sweetie. You fought Jace three times."

relations.note: Garruk says the witch cursed him and wants revenge.
Chandra believes Lili is nice and wants to rescue her.
Moiren hunted the Town with two dozen cathars.
relations.quote: Two dozen of us cathars joined up to hunt down Hanweir

relations.note: Opal tells the allies she must inform the Theorist.
relations.quote: the Theorist needs to know you're here

relations.note: Opal is the Echoverse counterpart of the true Liliana.
relations.quote: The true Liliana is a necromancer.

relations.note: Moiren shelters Tam and fights beside her.
relations.quote: Her gifts come in many forms.
